precision.consumer: any consumer that wants each kept mask to be right
precision.description: config defaults, unchanged: pooled score cut with the calibrated per-group raise for text_like

subtraction.consumer: residual isolation, where a missed mask contaminates the background silently and recall is therefore the quantity of interest
subtraction.description: pooled score cut applied to EVERY group, text_like included. NOT a proposed config change; a different consumer's cut.
